props.gloss_en: the mishna: [a woman may not go out] with a kavul into the public domain
the kavul the mishna speaks of is a slave's seal (kavla de'avda)
[on that reading] but a woollen cap is fine
the kavul the mishna speaks of is a woollen cap
[on that reading] and all the more so a slave's seal [is forbidden]
the baraita: a woman goes out with a kavul and with an istema to the courtyard
R' Shimon ben Elazar: even with a kavul to the public domain
R' Shimon ben Elazar's rule: whatever is below the hairnet, one goes out with it
...whatever is above the hairnet, one does not go out with it
what is an istema? R' Abbahu: bizyonei
what is bizyonei? Abaye said Rav said: kalya parochei
the Tosefta: an istema is not subject to [the law of] kilayim
...and it does not become impure with nega'im
...and one does not go out with it to the public domain
in R' Shimon's name they said: it is also not subject to [the decree of] brides' crowns
Shmuel: a slave goes out with a seal that is on his neck
Shmuel: but not with a seal that is on his clothing
this [Shmuel's permission] is where his master made it for him
that [the mishna's kavul, on Shmuel's reading] is where he made it for himself
[the seal on his clothing is forbidden] lest it break, and he be afraid, and fold it and put it on his shoulder
R' Yochanan: one who goes out with a cloak folded and lying on his shoulders on Shabbat is liable to a sin-offering
Shmuel: all the Rabbis of the Exilarch's house may not go out in sealed cloaks
Shmuel to Rav Chinnana bar Sheila: except you
for the Exilarch's house are not particular about you

supports.gloss_en: ותניא נמי הכי: יוצאה אשה בכבול ובאיסטמא לחצר... -- the baraita has a woman going out with a kavul
כדרב יצחק בר יוסף... היוצא בטלית מקופלת ומונחת לו על כתפיו בשבת חייב חטאת
וכי הא דאמר ליה שמואל לרב חיננא בר שילא: כולהו רבנן דבי ריש גלותא לא ליפקו בסרבלי חתימי, לבר מינך

objections.gloss_en: ומי אמר שמואל הכי? והאמר שמואל: יוצא העבד בחותם שבצוארו אבל לא בחותם שבכסותו -- did Shmuel say this? but Shmuel said a slave goes out with a seal on his neck!

answered_by.gloss_en: לא קשיא: הא דעבד ליה רביה, הא דעבד איהו לנפשיה (= p_okimta_shmuel_rabei, p_okimta_matnitin_lenafshei)

objections.gloss_en: במאי אוקימתא להא דשמואל -- דעבד ליה רביה? בחותם שבכסותו אמאי לא! -- if the master made it, why not with a seal on his clothing?

answered_by.gloss_en: דילמא מיפסק, ומירתת ומיקפל ליה ומחית ליה אכתפיה (= p_dilma_mifsak)
